$comment: Packages = the route table (Stage B rev4 R11). Transcribed from the Joe-ruled package list
(rev4 Package List, ruled 09.23.26) and the plan's R11 table. An uncurated option's id is built
from its endpoint path(s) in kebab-case (search-then-size is the plan's own name); a curated
option's label is that curated row's name.
Jev picks ONE row (or none_fit) from the rows with jev: true, offered in THIS FILE'S ROW ORDER.
dev_radar has jev: false: it runs only when named. That row's options become the menu.
Row shape: {id, jev, use_when, not_this, free: {how, curated?} | null, options: [...]}.
free.curated names the free curated row when the free path is one.
An option is {id, label, curated: <curated-workflows.json id>} or
{id, label, endpoints: [{call, countLow, countHigh, role}], quote, ceiling} — the curated shape,
so the ledger, execution.md and check_r6 E2 read it unchanged. A curated option keeps its own
row's quote. quote/ceiling on the others are written by
The 14 tested use_when sentences are byte-identical to
tools/socialcrawl/fixtures/jev-t2-route-criteria.json (T2, 14/14). Don't reword one without a re-test.

none_fit.criterion: The person wants a specific kind of data from a platform, marketplace or app that none of the options above is built to pull, and a plain web search would give only a rough answer.
none_fit.packageConfidenceNote: No package-confidence line: confidence doesn't separate right from wrong (a wrong pick scored 0.77, the lowest right one 0.73). The p(none_fit) trigger replaces it.
